verdict.rationale: Statsig's docs describe the Console API as the CRUD API for performing the actions on console.statsig.com without the web UI, which directly states UI parity. A public versioned OpenAPI spec, a versioning guarantee, and a CLI for create/update/delete in CI/CD back this up. The docs-path OpenAPI probe 404s, but the spec is published at api.statsig.com, so this does not contradict parity. Missing for 10: endpoint-level evidence that every console area (e.g., analytics, Warehouse Native, AI evals) is covered, and independent or hands-on confirmation of full parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
Statsig keeps the OpenAPI spec for this API version up-to-date.
Statsig guarantees that each version won't break existing usage
Create, update, and delete configs through commands, run them in scripts, or integrate Statsig configuration into CI/CD pipelines.
